includes: acts (id, team slug, act, thread, ts, allowlisted meta, HMAC seat ids)
members (HMAC id, kind, role — never the seat name)
lanes (id, state, times, HMAC owner/creator, goal_id, depends_on, project with seat tokens HMAC'd — never title/detail/branch)
omits: lanes.branch (seat/topic refs re-identify the HMAC; merged pr/sha already ride allowlisted meta)
meta keys not on the structural allowlist (urgent_reason, risk, chosen_approach, and any unknown key)
pseudonym: HMAC-SHA256(member_id, per-release salt), seat_<12 hex>. Mapping is never written into the public directory. Unlinkable across releases.
note: This is the PUBLIC artifact. pnpm corpus:snapshot is the PRIVATE raw corpus and must not upload.
